title: Regenerating ammo rack subsystem (dynamic attributes)
description: Per-instance attributes of a regenerating ammo rack: which delivery spec it holds, and on which service channels upstream loaders can find it. Capacity and regeneration rate are model-level fields and live in the static attribute file.

definition.description: Resource location of the subsystem model, pointing at the matching rack static attribute definition.

belt_definition.description: Delivery spec: every hand-over takes a copy of it; fields match the ammo content format. remaining only describes the template itself and is filled from actual stock on hand-over, so a delivered instance may have remaining < length. length is the rounds per delivery (and per-delivery cap) and must not exceed the model capacity.

container_id.description: Optional content-pack container model used for item restore, capacity and presentation; omitted means virtual feeding. Only identifier parsing and persistence are implemented at this stage.

label.description: Belt display name, shown literally on the weapon HUD. When empty, the display text of the first ammo type is used. Display only: it takes no part in pool grouping, routing or identity.

count.description: Consecutive rounds of the same ammo type.

pattern.description: Ordered ammo pattern: entries expand in written order, the round position is (length - remaining) % patternTotal.

length.description: Rounds per belt. Independent of the model capacity: capacity is how much the rack stores, length is how many one delivery may carry. length greater than capacity is a configuration error and is rejected at decode time.

recharge.description: Optional self-recharge: when declared, the launcher holding a loaded belt refills spent rounds at this rate up to length.

regen_per_minute.description: Recharge rate in rounds per minute.

regen_delay.description: Seconds to pause recharge after a successful shot.

energy_cost_per_round.description: Energy per refilled round, paid from the grid provided by the holder.

ammo_discovery_inputs.description: Service channels this rack accepts. Autoloaders reach it through these channels. Channels express a service class only (e.g. ammo_57mm) and carry no business signals.
